meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

copy.tagline: 让 AI 助手改用 OpenCode 驱动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用命令行工具管理 AI 智能体
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to OpenCode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are managing AI agents via command line

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 多了一项能力:运行 agent 时可以用 OpenCode 当后台,通过它调用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型,不再只走 Claude。安装时会把 OpenCode 文件复制进项目、注册依赖并重建镜像。
howto.when: 当你要求把 agent 后台换成 OpenCode,或让某个 agent 组改用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等提供商时触发;装好后还需在宿主机上执行配置和重启。

say.text: 帮我把项目切到 OpenCode,再用 DeepSeek 跑 agent。
say.note: 会复制 provider 文件并重建容器镜像。

say.text: 把 agent 组 dev 改成 opencode provider 并重启。
帮我配好 OPENCODE_MODEL,再注册 DeepSeek 密钥。
say.note: 会写环境变量并添加 OneCLI 密钥。

howto.what_en: After install, agents can use OpenCode as their backend instead of Claude, enabling OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc. Install copies provider files into the repo, wires registration, adds dependencies, and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to use OpenCode as the agent backend, or to switch an agent group's provider to OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc. Configuration and restart are then done on the host.

say_en.text: Switch the project to the OpenCode backend and run agents with DeepSeek.
say_en.note: Copies provider files and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Point agent group dev's provider to opencode and restart.
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update and restart.

say_en.text: Set OPENCODE_MODEL in .env and register the DeepSeek key.
say_en.note: Writes env vars and adds a OneCLI secret.
